homeSummaryHtml:
My interest in technology began with an introductory Python course in high school, where I discovered how programming and logical thinking could be used to solve real-world problems. Since then, I have focused on learning by doing, building systems, experimenting with new technologies, and solving practical challenges through hands-on work.

I am currently pursuing dual Bachelor's degrees in Computer Technology Information Systems and Cyber and Network Security at Guilford College. My academic path reflects a strong interest in understanding both how systems work and how they can be secured in real-world environments.

Originally from Iran, my multicultural background has shaped the way I approach challenges and learning. Moving between cultures taught me adaptability and persistence, qualities that influence how I work and solve problems today.

I am naturally drawn to hands-on projects because they allow me to explore ideas in a practical way. I enjoy breaking down complex systems, understanding how they function, and improving them through experimentation and iteration.

I value collaboration and enjoy working with others who share an interest in technology. Whether working independently or as part of a team, I am motivated by curiosity, problem-solving, and the process of building something meaningful.
